title: Smart Data Models - Project Haystack - Equip
description: Equipment asset. See the Haystack 'Equips' chapter chapter. (Project Haystack 4.0.0 entity 'equip', Xeto spec ph::Equip. Tag names verbatim; marker tags in hasTag.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity. Stands for the Haystack 'id' Ref tag.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Equip'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasTag.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/ph/4.0.0#hasTag'. The marker tags of the entity, verbatim Haystack tag names, as Haystack's own RDF export encodes markers (ph:hasTag). Must contain 'equip'. It carries the entity subtype markers (e.g. actuator, airHandlingEquip, airTerminalUnit, ates, battery, boiler), the options chosen for Haystack choices and any other marker such as his, cur, writable or hvac. Values expand to the Haystack def IRIs in JSON-LD. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/docHaystack/Rdf#instances. Marker tags that Haystack declares on equip: vfd

dis.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/ph/4.0.0#dis'. Display name for an entity. See the Haystack 'Ontology' chapter chapter. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-ph/dis

ahuZoneDelivery.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#ahuZoneDelivery'. AHU delivery method of conditioned air to the zone. Haystack choice: the value is one of its options, which is also a marker tag of the entity (listed in hasTag). Values are Haystack def names; in JSON-LD they expand to the def IRIs. Applies to equip entities of type airHandlingEquip. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/ahuZoneDelivery

airRef.description: Relationship. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#airRef'. Air flows from the referent to this entity. Points to the entity (typically an Equip) that produces it (tagged 'air-output'). Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/airRef
